 Ja Nai Wright Hello! I cover Anne Arundel County for WMAR-2 News. If you have a story idea to share, please email me at janai.wright@wmar.com
 ANNE ARUNDEL COUNTY, Md — Anne Arundel County is set to have a new county executive and five new faces on its County Council, marking the first change in leadership for the county in more than 8 years.
 Just after midnight, 100% of the votes in Anne Arundel County were in and counted. Although the race had not yet been officially called, Democrat Allison Pickard maintained a lead, having 34,000 more votes than her opponent, Dave Crawford.
 Carloads of ballots came pouring into the Anne Arundel County Board of Elections office once the polls closed.
 In addition to a new county executive, there are five new faces among the Anne Arundel County Council, including one familiar face: former Annapolis Mayor Gavin Buckley for District 6. 
 Republican Nathan Volke will continue to represent District 3 alongside Julie Hummer, who represents District 4.
 Since the county executive race was not called before midnight, it may take a few hours or several weeks before the winner is officially certified. Either way, the county will be under new leadership for the first time in over 8 years.
 This is a developing story, so check back with WMAR2News.com for updates. Email the WMAR-2 Newsroom if you have info, photos or videos to share.
